widgets.text:
Play as Harry, Ron and Hermione; each has their own skill and spell use.
Switch characters to solve puzzles.
widgets.label: Characters

widgets.text:
Harry: Expecto Patronum and flying.
Ron: finds secret passages.
Hermione: reads/uses books and spells others can't.
widgets.label: Who does what

widgets.text:
Dementors: cast Expecto Patronum.
Boggarts: Riddikulus.
Use the character whose spell fits the obstacle.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Hogwarts, Hogsmeade, the Forbidden Forest, the Shrieking Shack.
widgets.label: Places

widgets.text: Beans buy items; chocolate frogs heal; cards hidden around.
widgets.label: Items

widgets.text: Wizard cards and secret items scattered through the levels.
widgets.label: Collect

widgets.text: Rescue Buckbeak and Sirius by the end of the year.
